Radiology Report
Date: 08/21/2026
Patient: Vertie Rutherford, 70 y/o F

MRI lumbar spine 08/21/2026: L5-S1 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.

Findings: The lumbar spine demonstrates normal alignment. No evidence of vertebral body compression fractures. The L5-S1 level shows a disc herniation protruding into the right neural foramen causing moderate stenosis. This stenosis is in contact with the exiting right S1 nerve root. No other significant canal or foraminal narrowing noted at other levels.

Impression: L5-S1 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root. No acute osseous abnormalities identified.
